City opens a new cycle lane on Karl-Heine-Strasse

Published 19 October 2026 by the press office of the city of Leipzig.

The city opened a protected cycle lane of 1.2 kilometres on Karl-Heine-Strasse on 19 October 2026.

The lane is separated from car traffic by kerbs and runs in both directions between the Felsenkeller and the Plagwitz station.

"More people will ride to work when they feel safe," said the head of the mobility office.
